name: Vestige
tagline: Local-first Rust MCP memory that answers what-caused-this via causal Backfill
description:
Vestige is local-first Rust MCP memory for coding agents.
Most memory systems answer what-is-like-this; Vestige answers what-caused-this via backward-only causal Backfill.
Shared entities are the join key; similarity is excluded from ranking.

Advertised tools: recall, smart_ingest, backfill. Prefer recall. Do not advertise search (hidden v2.2 alias).

Proof: no LLM in the memory path, exact FSRS-6 decay, local-first. Proven on local/synthetic traces. Not a production claim.

Launch via npx with package vestige-mcp-server version 2.3.0; binary name is vestige-mcp.
GUIs do not inherit PATH or expand tilde; paste absolute path from which vestige-mcp for global installs.
Linux note: wait for v2.4.0 before using the global binary on older glibc distros.
macOS works with the current package.

Per-project store uses an absolute data-dir path.
Unknown CLI flags exit with status 1.

Package page: https://www.npmjs.com/package/vestige-mcp-server

install.notes: Preferred launch uses npx with package vestige-mcp-server. Alternative: paste absolute path from which vestige-mcp into Cline MCP settings. Per-project store uses absolute data-dir. Ubuntu 22.04 and Debian 12: wait for v2.4.0 for the global binary. Proven local/synthetic only. Advertised tools: recall, smart_ingest, backfill.
